title: Commercial Paralegal
description:
Commercial Paralegal - Watford

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Commercial Paralegal with strong contract and document management experience to join a well- known international business in Watford on an initial 6-month contract basis, with a strong likelihood of extension.

As a Commercial Paralegal you will be responsible for reviewing executed contracts, extracting and coding key information and ensuring documents are accurately recoded and uploaded to the relevant systems.

Your skills and experience should include:
- Previous Commercial Paralegal experience
- Strong contract and document management experience
- Excellent attention to detail and organisation
- Experience handling high volumes of documentation

The role is full-time, with the firm looking for someone to work 4 days per week in the Watford office and 1 day from home.

The role is inside IR35, with a day rate of £200-£250 per day ( £52,000-£65,000 annual equivalent).

The ideal start date is October, although November availability may also be considered.

If you are a Commercial Paralegal looking for a new contract opportunity and can commit to 4 days per week in Watford, apply now or get in touch with Alexiane for a confidential conversation.

title: Commercial Property Legal Assistant
description:
Commercial Property Legal Assistant

Are you an experienced Commercial Property Legal Assistant who enjoys getting stuck into the matter work as well as the admin? This St Albans role will give you real variety in a team that will value what you bring.

We are working with a highly regarded commercial law firm that wants to add a Commercial Property Legal Assistant to its busy Commercial Real Estate team. The firm has a professional but friendly culture, flexible working and a supportive team where you can keep learning and progressing.

The role combines legal secretarial support with legal assistant work, so you'll get a real mix of both. The team is very busy, so they need someone with commercial property experience who can hit the ground running and support several fee-earners at once.

The role

As Commercial Property Legal Assistant, your duties will include:
- Preparing HM Land Registry applications (AP1, TR1), dealing with requisitions and tracking progress
- Getting office copies, carrying out official and map searches, and asking for applications to be expedited
- Preparing draft SDLT returns and calculations
- Post-completion work, including notices of transfer or charge and deeds of covenant
- Preparing lease and deed summaries, schedules of deeds and sales packs
- Drafting basic CPSE replies and reports on title for fee-earners to review
- Audio and copy typing through BigHand, plus formatting and proofreading documents
- File opening, AML and ID checks (SmartSearch and Legl), and file closures
- Financial admin, including invoices, payment requests and credit control
- Managing diaries and arranging meetings

About you
- Experience in a commercial property team
- A good working knowledge of HM Land Registry processes and SDLT
- Comfortable using Word, Outlook, Excel, DocuSign and PDF software (iManage experience is helpful)
- Able to juggle competing priorities and still meet deadlines
- High attention to detail and a confident phone manner

What's on offer
- £35,000 to £40,000 salary, depending on experience
- 25 days' annual leave
- Workplace pension
- Death in service cover at four times salary
- Extra discretionary perks
- Ongoing training and development
- Based in St Albans - some hybrid working may be available (depending on experience)

If you're a Commercial Property Legal Assistant, or a Commercial Property Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant ready for more hands-on work, I'd love to hear from you. Apply today or get in touch for a confidential discussion.

title: Commercial Property Legal Secretary
company: Harwood Recruitment Solutions Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
A fantastic opportunity has become available for an experienced Commercial Property Legal Secretary or Assistant to join a well-established, full-service law firm at its St Albans office, they are known for its excellent reputation and continued growth, the firm works with a wide variety of commercial clients across the region and offers an engaging and supportive working environment.

This is a full-time, permanent role suited to a motivated and detail-oriented individual with strong administrative skills and a desire to build a lasting career within commercial property support.

Key Responsibilities:
- Providing high-quality secretarial support including audio typing, document production and preparation
- Handling a range of administrative duties within a busy Commercial Property department
- Opening new client files, preparing contract packs, and managing cases using the firm's internal systems
- Managing diaries, scheduling appointments, coordinating meetings, and handling telephone enquiries
- Preparing and drafting commercial property documentation and correspondence, including title documents, forms, and searches
- Communicating effectively with clients, estate agents, lenders, and supporting the wider legal team as needed

The Ideal Candidate Will Have:
- The ability to work independently, manage workload and prioritise deadlines effectively
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with a confident and professional telephone manner
- A high level of attention to detail and a commitment to providing outstanding client service
- Prior experience in a similar legal secretarial role, ideally within Commercial Property or another property-based area

If you're an organised and proactive individual looking for your next role within a respected and growing legal firm, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Family Paralegal
description:
Family Paralegal - North West London

This award-winning, modern law firm is expanding its Family Department and seeking an experienced family paralegal to join the team!

What is in it for you?

You will receive a competitive salary, high levels of autonomy and clear chances to progress in this growing, ambitious firm.

The role:

As the successful family paralegal, you will benefit from an existing, varied caseload. Typical matters will include Domestic Violence files and non-molestation orders amongst others.

Other duties will include, but are not limited to:
- Attending client meetings
- Supporting qualified staff
- Managing your own files
- Drafting and preparing documents
- Liaising with the LAA
- Using the CCMS

You:

We are inviting application from those who:
- Are experienced family paralegals with a strong academic background
- Have previous experience and commitment to publicly funded Family Law
- Possess excellent IT and organisational skills, with strong client care ethos

For more information on this experienced family paralegal opportunity, get your CV to me today for immediate consideration!

title: Legal Secretary - Commercial Property
description:
Think Specialist Recruitment are delighted to be working with a fantastic Law firm based in St Albans. This brilliant organisation have an exciting opportunity for a Legal Secretary to join their expanding team. This position would suit someone who has previous experience within a similar position, and knowledge of legal practice, experience within commercial property is a must have.
Monday - Friday 9am - 5:30pm
This position is based within the office for 5 days
Salary - 35,000 - 38,000
Some of the duties will include:
- Copy and audio typing various documents
- Proof reading, amending and comparing documents
- Transcribing and formatting documents
- Telephone and email communication with clients, ensuring messages are passed on promptly
- Converting, reformatting and proofing documents
- Dealing with land registry applications
- Drafting letters to clients, HMRC and Solicitors
- Requesting planning documentation from local authority
- Calling lenders to request documentation
- Organising diaries and required, arranging meetings
- Other ad-hoc support as required

The suitable candidate:
- Commercial property experience is required
- Previous experience within a similar position
- Strong communication skills on all levels
- Ability to manage a varied workload
- Good organisational skills
- Keen eye for detail
- Ability to work well as part of a team
- Happy to be office based

Looking for the next step in your career? Think Specialist Recruitment.

Think Specialist Recruitment is an independent support staff recruitment agency based in Hemel Hempstead and working across the Herts, Beds and Bucks area.
